items.name: Coast Forge — Golden Guard (AURA TEST)
items.description: While this test aura is enabled, you and allied creatures within 5 feet times your Proficiency Bonus gain a bonus to all saving throws equal to your Charisma modifier (minimum +1). Multiple copies of the aura do not stack; use the highest bonus. Manually enable or disable this test aura.

items.name: Coast Forge — Crimson Dread (AURA TEST)
items.description: While this test aura is enabled, hostile creatures within 30 feet of you take a -2 penalty to all saving throws. The source is not affected. Manually enable or disable this test aura.

items.description: While this test aura is enabled, every other creature within 10 feet of you, regardless of disposition, gains a +1 bonus to Armor Class. The source is not affected. Manually enable or disable this test aura.

items.name: Coast Forge — Blue Ward (ACTIVITY TEST)
items.description: As a Bonus Action, you can emanate a 60-foot aura for 1 minute. You and friendly creatures within the aura gain +2 Armor Class. Once used, this feature cannot be used again until you finish a Long Rest.

description.chatFlavor: Apply the aura to yourself. Allies gain +2 AC within 60 ft. Manually remove the source aura from the actor after 1 minute. If the custom effect is not applied by Midi-QOL, use the effect application control or apply the configured aura manually; do not consume a second use.
